items.caption: A modern redrawing of 先 in Shuowen seal-script style. The Shuowen analysis names 先 as the phonetic element in 洗.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style strokes form 先 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: Shows the phonetic component named in the historical analysis; it is not an early form of 洗 and does not independently establish the sound relationship.

limitations.text: No verified historical glyph of 洗 is shown here. The early oracle-bone identification is disputed, and no suitable, verified image of that character was established.
